#### `Database::alignTimeZone()`

```php
public static function alignTimeZone($connection, $adapter)
```

MySQL session time zone = PHP's (SERVER_TIMEZONE), so that NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP columns and the times PHP
writes (the audit log) use the same clock. DB_TIMEZONE=server keeps the database server's own time zone.

<a name="migrations"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Migrations

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Migrations
```

Source: [framework/core/Migrations.php:23](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Migrations.php#L23)

Class Migrations
application/migrations/&lt;number&gt;_&lt;name&gt;.sql: php caligrafer.php migrate runs, in number order, the files that never
ran on this database, and records each one in caligrafy_migrations (its name, its sha256, when). A file is never run
twice: change the database with a new file, not by editing one that ran (status shows it as "changed", and deploy
warns). The deploy step (php caligrafer.php deploy) runs them after the create_db.sql scripts. Forward only: undo a
change with a new migration.

The statements of a file are split on ; outside quotes and comments. A file stops at its first failing statement:
it is not recorded, the statements before it stay applied (MySQL commits a CREATE or ALTER at once), so write each
file so that it can run again (IF NOT EXISTS), or keep one change per file.

### Constants

+ `FOLDER = 'application/migrations'`
+ `TABLE = 'caligrafy_migrations'`
+ `PATTERN = '/^(\d{1,14})_([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\.sql$/'`

<a name="cache"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Cache

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Cache
```

Source: [framework/core/Cache.php:25](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Cache.php#L25)

Class Cache (2.18.0)

```
$rates = Cache::remember('exchange-rates', 600, fn () => $this->fetchRates());   // at most once every 10 minutes
Cache::put('report:2026-11', $rows, 3600);  Cache::get('report:2026-11', []);  Cache::forget('report:2026-11');
```

CACHE_STORE in .env: database (the default with DB_ACTIVATE=true: the caligrafy_cache table, which the deploy step
and php caligrafer.php platform install create, shared by the web server, the queue, scheduled jobs and every
server), file (the default without a database: a private folder of the temporary directory, of one server and one
system user, so the command line and the web server each have their own) or off (nothing is kept, remember()
always runs its function). Values are stored as JSON: strings, numbers, booleans,
null and arrays (an object comes back as an array). $seconds null keeps a value until it is forgotten or flushed.
php caligrafer.php cache clear empties the store.

### Constants

+ `TABLE = 'caligrafy_cache'`
+ `STORES = array('file', 'database', 'off')`

+ [`Cache::get()`](#cache-get)
